Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.en: Have you seen Ariel around anywhere?
I love adventures... sometimes... as long as they're not too scary.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.cz: Miluju dobrodružství... někdy... pokud nejsou příliš strašidelná.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.en: Gee, I uh... I think I may be coming down with something. I've got this cough...
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.cz: Jé, já... myslím, že na mě něco leze. Mám tenhle kašel...

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.en: Ariel's my best friend. I'd do anything for her!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.cz: Ariel je moje nejlepší kamarádka. Udělal bych pro ni cokoliv!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.en: I've explored lots of shipwrecks! Just... just not by myself.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.cz: Prozkoumal jsem spoustu vraků! Jen... jen ne sám.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.en: Wanna see my shark impression? Grrrrr! Was that scary?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.cz: Chceš vidět můj žraločí dojem? Grrrrr! Bylo to strašidelné?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.en: Do YOU know what a dinglehopper is?
Wh-what was that?! Did you hear something?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.cz: Co-co to bylo?! Slyšel jsi něco?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.en: My friend Scuttle says those lights in the sky are jellyfish who live in a really dark ocean.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.cz: Můj kamarád Scuttle říká, že ty světla na obloze jsou medúzy, které žijí v opravdu temném oceánu.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.en: It's raining again? Bet all those people on land are happy. The water's great!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.cz: Zase prší? Vsadím se, že všichni ti lidé na souši jsou šťastní. Voda je skvělá!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.en: Wow, that sun sure is bright today. Sometimes it's hard to tell from under the sea.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Barks_.cz: Wow, to slunce je dnes opravdu jasné. Někdy je těžké to poznat z pod moře.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I'm great! How 'bout you?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Mám se skvěle! A co ty?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I'm great, too!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Mám se taky skvěle!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I'm okay, I guess.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jsem v pořádku, myslím.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Not so good, actually.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Vlastně to není tak dobré.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: That's good.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: To je dobré.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Because otherwise, that would be... well, it would be sad. Or upsetting. Or worry-ish? Worry-ing? Yeah, it would be worrying.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Protože jinak by to bylo... no, bylo by to smutné. Nebo znepokojující. Nebo starostlivé? Starostlivé? Jo, bylo by to znepokojující.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Oh, uh... sometimes I feel that way too.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Oh, ehm... někdy se tak cítím taky.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Not great, but not bad, just somewhere in the middle.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Není to skvělé, ale ani špatné, prostě tak někde uprostřed.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Oh, uh... I'm sorry.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Oh, ehm... omlouvám se.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I hope your day starts to get better. Let me know if I can help, okay?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Doufám, že se tvůj den začne zlepšovat. Dej mi vědět, jestli můžu pomoct, jo?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Um... Sometimes? When they're not scary.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Ehm... Někdy? Když nejsou děsivé.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Do you like them?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Líbí se ti?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I love them!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Miluju je!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: It depends on the adventure.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Záleží na dobrodružství.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I'm like you; I get too scared!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jsem jako ty; mám příliš velký strach!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: You sound like Ariel.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Zníš jako Ariel.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Bet you're brave like her, huh?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Vsadím se, že jsi statečný jako ona, co?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: That makes sense.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: To dává smysl.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: My favorite ones are when we look for treasure on the sea floor, not in some dark, scary shipwreck.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Moje oblíbené jsou, když hledáme poklad na mořském dně, ne v nějaké temné, děsivé vraku.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Hey, sometimes it's smart to be scared.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Hele, někdy je chytré mít strach.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Like with sharks, and giant squid, and... and King Triton when he's yelling.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Třeba s žraloky, obřími chobotnicemi a... a králem Tritonem, když křičí.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Hey, how'd you know?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Hele, jak jsi to věděl?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I wanna get Ariel a gift, but I don't know what to get her.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Chci Ariel koupit dárek, ale nevím, co jí mám dát.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Just follow your gut.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Prostě se řiď svým instinktem.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Hm, yeah, giving gifts can be stressful.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Hm, jo, dávat dárky může být stresující.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: What sort of things does she like?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jaké věci má ráda?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Is that like the thoughts in my head? 'Cause that's the problem — I don't have any! Guess I'll just keep swimming and see if I get an idea.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Je to jako myšlenky v mé hlavě? Protože to je problém — žádné nemám! Asi budu jen plavat dál a uvidím, jestli mě něco napadne.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Well, she loves human stuff.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: No, ona miluje lidské věci.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: You know, anything they use that we don't have under the sea.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Víš, cokoliv, co používají a co my pod mořem nemáme.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: What about a fork?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Co takhle vidlici?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: A book?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Knihu?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: A pair of shoes?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Pár bot?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I don't know what that is. But I can ask Scuttle next time I see him.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Nevím, co to je. Ale můžu se na to zeptat Scuttla, až ho příště uvidím.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I guess I just need to think some more.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Asi si na to musím ještě víc promyslet.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I don't know what that is. But I can ask Scuttle next time I see him.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Nevím, co to je. Ale můžu se na to zeptat Scuttla, až ho příště uvidím.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: You mean like humans wear on their, uh... oh, their feet? I think she's already got some of those.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Myslíš jako to, co nosí lidé na, ehm... oh, na nohou? Myslím, že už nějaké má.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Sometimes, I guess... but I have lots of friends.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Někdy, asi... ale mám spoustu přátel.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Hey, uh... are you feeling lonely, {PlayerName}?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Ahoj, ehm... cítíš se osaměle, {PlayerName}?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Nope, I'm never lonely!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Ne, nikdy se necítím osaměle!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I do sometimes, but I'm okay now.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Někdy ano, ale teď jsem v pořádku.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: A little, yeah.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Trochu, jo.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Gee, uh... that's great!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jé, ehm... to je skvělé!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I'm glad you aren't.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jsem rád, že nejsi.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Guess everybody feels lonely sometimes, huh?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Asi se někdy každý cítí osaměle, co?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: But I'm glad you're okay now.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Ale jsem rád, že teď jsi v pořádku.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Can I help?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Můžu ti nějak pomoci?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Just talking about it helped already.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Už jen mluvení o tom pomohlo.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Maybe we can hang out a bit?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Možná si můžeme trochu popovídat?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Tell me a joke?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Pověz mi vtip?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: It did? Wow! How 'bout you come talk to me when you're lonely, and I'll come talk to you when I am?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Opravdu? Páni! Co kdybys přišel za mnou, když se cítíš osaměle, a já za tebou přijdu, když se budu cítit osaměle já?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Sure!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jasně!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I always like spending time with you.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Vždycky rád trávím čas s tebou.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Okay... Uh... Oh, I know! How do big fish tell you they're sad?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Dobře... Ehm... Oh, už vím! Jak ti velké ryby říkají, že jsou smutné?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: They let out a BLUE WHALE.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Vydávají MODRÉHO VELRYBU.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Um, I don't know. I guess I never really thought about it.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Ehm, nevím. Asi jsem o tom nikdy moc nepřemýšlel.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: What do you think I should do?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Co si myslíš, že bych měl udělat?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Go on BIG adventures!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Vydej se na VELKÁ dobrodružství!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Work in King Triton's court.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Pracuj na dvoře krále Tritona.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Have yourself a fishy family.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Založ si rybí rodinku.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Maybe. I've already done lots of that, though.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Možná. Už jsem toho hodně zažil.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: You mean be like Sebastian? I'm not sure. That seems pretty stressful.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Myslíš být jako Sebastian? Nejsem si jistý. To vypadá dost stresující.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: That sounds kinda nice. I mean, in the future. Way, WAY in the future!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: To zní docela hezky. Myslím, v budoucnu. O hodně, O HODNĚ v budoucnu!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I never really thought about it.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: O tom jsem nikdy moc nepřemýšlel.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I always did wonder why Ariel wanted to, though.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Vždycky mě zajímalo, proč to Ariel chtěla.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: She wanted to find her own way in the world.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Chtěla najít svou vlastní cestu ve světě.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: She was in love!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Byla zamilovaná!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Yeah, I don't get it. The ocean is better!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jo, to nechápu. Oceán je lepší!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Yeah, I think you're right.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jo, myslím, že máš pravdu.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: She always wants to learn more and see new stuff. She's pretty incredible like that.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Vždycky chce vědět víc a vidět nové věci. Je v tom opravdu úžasná.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Oh, she wanted to live on land way before she fell in love.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Ona chtěla žít na souši dávno předtím, než se zamilovala.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: But that made her find a way to do it.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Ale to jí pomohlo najít způsob, jak to udělat.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I think so, too. At least for me.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Myslím, že taky. Aspoň pro mě.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Well, I guess I spend lots of time with Sebastian now... but Scuttle's lots funnier.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: No, asi teď trávím hodně času se Sebastianem... ale Scuttle je mnohem vtipnější.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: How about you?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: A co ty?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: All the Villagers are my best friends!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Všichni vesničané jsou moji nejlepší přátelé!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: A family member.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Člen rodiny.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: An old childhood friend.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Starý kamarád z dětství.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Really? Wow! That's cool.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Opravdu? Páni! To je super.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: You sure are lucky, huh?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Ty jsi fakt šťastný, co?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: That's nice.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: To je hezké.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Family IS really important.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Rodina je OPRAVDU důležitá.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Like me and Ariel!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jako já a Ariel!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: That's great, {PlayerName}.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: To je skvělé, {PlayerName}.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I try to be brave, but mostly I guess I yell and try to swim away really fast...
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Snažím se být statečný, ale většinou asi jen křičím a snažím se rychle uplavat...

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: What about you?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: A co ty?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Pretty much the same as you.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Docela podobně jako ty.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I try to stay brave.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Snažím se zůstat statečný.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: I NEVER feel scared!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: NIKDY se nebojím!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: You do?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Opravdu?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Thanks for telling me. It's nice to know I'm not the only one.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Díky, že jsi mi to řekl. Je fajn vědět, že nejsem sám.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: That's great, {PlayerName}.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: To je skvělé, {PlayerName}.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: You'll have to give me some tips.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Budeš mi muset dát pár tipů.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Never?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Nikdy?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Whoa...
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jé...

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Me? No way! Nuh-uh!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Já? Ani náhodou! Nene!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Well... okay, maybe a little. A lot. But isn't everyone?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: No... dobře, možná trochu. Hodně. Ale není to tak u každého?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Sharks aren't so bad.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Žraloci nejsou tak špatní.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Yeah, sharks definitely scare me.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jo, žraloci mě rozhodně děsí.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: There are WAY scarier things out there.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Tam venku jsou mnohem děsivější věci.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Some maybe, but I don't think I've met any of them.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Některé možná, ale myslím, že jsem se s žádným z nich nesetkal.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: If they didn't have such pointy teeth, it might not be so bad.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Kdyby neměli tak ostré zuby, možná by to nebylo tak špatné.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: There ARE?!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Opravdu jsou?!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Well, I definitely don't wanna know about 'em!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: No, rozhodně nechci o nich vědět!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Being with Ariel. She's my best friend.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Být s Ariel. Je to moje nejlepší kamarádka.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: How about you?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: A co ty?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Same for me: friends and family!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: To samé pro mě: přátelé a rodina!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Swimming all around the ocean.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Plavu si po celém oceánu.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Quiet activities where I can be alone.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Klidné aktivity, kde můžu být sám.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: That's great! I bet they love being with you, too.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: To je skvělé! Vsadím se, že tě mají taky rádi.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Oh yeah, I like that too.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jo, to se mi taky líbí.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Even if sometimes I get nervous, I do like exploring.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: I když se občas bojím, rád objevuju.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: Yeah, sometimes it's great to be alone.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Jo, někdy je fajn být sám.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.en: It's kinda hard to do that sometimes, though. It's pretty busy under the sea.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Discus.cz: Někdy je to ale docela těžké. Pod mořem je dost rušno.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_GiftTh.en: Wow! I've never gotten anything like this before.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_GiftTh.cz: Wow! Ještě jsem nikdy nic takového nedostal.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.en: Great day for a swim, huh, {PlayerName}?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.cz: Skvělý den na plavání, co říkáš, {PlayerName}?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.en: You can have legs OR a tail? Does Ariel know about this?!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.cz: Máš nohy NEBO ocas? Ví o tom Ariel?!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.en: You're not gonna tell King Triton we're here, are you?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.cz: Neřekneš králi Tritonovi, že jsme tady, že ne?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.en: You haven't seen any sharks here, have you?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.cz: Neviděl jsi tady žádné žraloky, že ne?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.en: Wanna do something fun today? I'm not busy or anything.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.cz: Chceš dneska dělat něco zábavného? Nejsem zaneprázdněný nebo tak.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.en: The ocean's really clear today. That helps with my allergies.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.cz: Dnes je oceán opravdu čistý. To mi pomáhá s alergiemi.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.en: Oh, hey! I wondered if I'd see you today.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.cz: Ahoj! Přemýšlel jsem, jestli tě dnes uvidím.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.en: The ocean's pretty at night, huh?
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.cz: Oceán je v noci pěkný, co říkáš?

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.en: Rain is so weird. It's just ocean, but in the air.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.cz: Déšť je tak zvláštní. Je to jen oceán, ale ve vzduchu.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.en: Ariel always likes watching the sun come up on the surface. It is kinda pretty, I guess.
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Greeti.cz: Ariel vždy ráda sleduje, jak vychází slunce na hladině. Je to vlastně docela hezké, myslím.

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Hangou.en: I had fun and there was no sharks! I'll be around, {PlayerName}!
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Hangou.cz: Bylo to zábavné a nebyly žádné žraloci! Budu tady, {PlayerName}!

Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Hangou.en: Sure... As long as there are no sharks...
Expansion04Main_Flounder/Flounder_Hangou.cz: Jasně... Pokud tu nebudou žádní žraloci...
